steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I think the situation's pretty clear to me now.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Deui m jyu, Neuisi. We assumed you were carrying that sword for nefarious purposes, but it was all a misunderstanding.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: We understand you burst into a home while running for your life.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: As for the ones who attacked you, witnesses weren't able to give too many details, but the L.G.D. will investigate to the best of our ability.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: However, there is the matter of compensation for the glass you broke...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I can't pay.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Alright, no need to worry. I actually came to inform you that your relative explained the situation and paid what you owe, so you're free to go.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: ...My relative?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I know it's not the best feeling, relying on family for your first visit to Lungmen.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: But in these circumstances, better you ask her for help than end up with a criminal record.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: You're quick with your sword, and you weren't the most forthcoming with an explanation. If you'd resisted arrest with that blade, it would've been a lot more trouble for all of us.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I'm glad you're keeping fit with kung fu, but do be more careful here in Lungmen.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Alright, Neuisi. We've returned your weapon, so hurry on back home.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: But I don't know...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Never mind. Doje.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Oh, it's you, Loubaan.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Take this. It's an ointment for your wounds.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I'm fine. Just a few scratches from the broken glass.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I appreciate you getting me out of jail. Doje.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: You sure know how to give an old woman a scare.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Lucky for you I noticed when you didn't pass by for two days. I asked around the neighborhood only to learn that you had men trying to kill you, and that you'd escaped into one of those fancy uptown apartment blocks.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: People have been watching me so closely?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: The waiter at the dai pai dong across the way. She loves to gossip.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Yes she does...

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Did you hear anything from her?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Nothing really.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I heard this shop is haunted. Apparently, a lot of people died here, many years ago.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: And I also heard that you make mysterious visits to the cemetery, tending to the grave of someone she doesn't know.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: *sigh* She's been reading those conspiracy magazines again. I'm afraid she'll lose her mind if she keeps at them.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: There is one thing she's right about, at least. You are rather strange, Loubaan.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I caused trouble, but you weren't afraid. You even came to my rescue.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Haha... I think you'll find that you're the strange one, Qiu.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: If I hadn't gone to the L.G.D. to explain things, would you really have just sat there without a word?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: People like me are not exactly trustworthy, and I didn't know who was chasing me. It would have been rather difficult to explain it all.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: A better move would have been to buy time and find an opportunity to escape.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: You think you could have escaped?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Bandit strongholds, merchant escorts. I've escaped a few times in the past.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Those aren't really the same.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Besides, didn't you say you were going to Yumen to look for someone?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Lungmen's about to link up with Yumen. If you miss this opportunity, the two cities will separate and go far apart.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: A nomadic city can travel dozens of li in a day. If you journey on foot like before, you'd be walking for months.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Doesn't matter to me if it's months early or months late, I'm fine either way.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: And anyway, Yumen is preparing for battle and not admitting travelers. Without a suitable title to my name, I wouldn't be able to enter regardless.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: 'Preparing for battle'... Conflict can be more unpredictable than the weather.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Considering you have someone to see, don't you feel some urgency?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Unless you're not worried they might die before you can meet.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Loubaan, how can I repay you for coming to my aid?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: How could I possibly ask something from a girl who spends her nights up in the rafters cradling her sword?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I do have a sword, after all.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Coming by to chat whenever you're free is enough for me.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: You have a safe place to hide here.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: And didn't you say that you were born in a river fort? Here in Lungmen, you can think of this flyover as the bridge across that river, and the street below is a little fort of your own.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: That old television can still play classic films on CD.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Just don't get too into them. Don't want you trying to play hero in real life.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Everything in this house is ancient artifacts from twenty or thirty years ago. If you start practicing your kung fu willy-nilly, you'll break it all.

steps.name: Voice on Television
steps.text: '...After traversing li upon li, so far from the jianghu, I fear that I shall never see her again.'

steps.name: Voice on Television
steps.text: 'Perhaps it is for the best that you disappear. Jianghu herself will follow you, an eternal source of foes, and I do not wish to see you to take up arms against all under Heaven...'
Qiubai shows no interest in the story playing out on the TV screen, simply holding down the fast-forward button.
A movie poster inadvertently caught her eye earlier that day, which led her to peruse the stock of the DVD shop.
But as she rummages through the dust-covered disks, she is unable to find the so-called Grandmaster among the other movies.

spans.text: But as she rummages through the dust-covered disks, she is unable to find the so-called

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: This 'hero' has nary a drop of blood on his hands, just like the one in that drama series.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: This really would have me believe that every time blood is drawn, all the kung fu masters dodge the splatter using qinggong.

a.text: 'Do it right, girl. This move here's a feint. You can take it easily.'
'This here is a shaving strike. Don't look away as you bring the blade down.'
'Oh, don't tell your parents we taught you these moves.'
'It's not that you're too young to be learning how to take up arms. It's just that... they probably still hope that you might look away.'

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: As if things could ever be that clean.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Qiu.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Are you asleep back there?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No, I'm awake.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Ah, good.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Can you help me watch the store?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You'd trust me with that?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Hasn't it already been more than two weeks since your last dust-up?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: You'll be fine. Not many customers this late at night, and our sign doesn't exactly bring in the crowds.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: I might not know what sort of people are chasing you, but in the twenty-odd years I've lived here, we haven't had many ruffians coming around.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: And if they do show?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Then you bring down the shutters and close the doors. No need to wait for me to come back. Just find a moment to put the key under the mat.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Also, there'll probably be some drunks looking for trouble in the middle of the night.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: If any of them come into the store and won't leave, just give them what they want to make them happy.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: These things happen, can't really avoid it. If they happen to you, don't take it to heart.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: If I really do run into one of those miscreants, I'll teach them a lesson.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Ah, no need to make a mountain out of a talpihill.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I won't, I'll just give them a scare.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You've shown me kindness, and I will do my best to repay it.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Mafaan nei la.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Those flowers you're holding are beautiful.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Haha, are they? I love white flowers too. It's a shame that they're not for a happy occasion.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Are you going to visit a grave?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: I suppose I am.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Life and death lie in the hands of Heaven, and it's not up to me to say if that's good or bad.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: However...

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No, nothing. I won't hold you up any longer.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Rental prices are on the wall, take a look.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Not even a 'funying gwonglam' from you, shopkeep?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: If you're just another drunk here to cause trouble, know that I've already kicked out a—

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: I see you recognize this knife.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I saw one just like it a month ago, stuck into the wall beside my antler.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: I hear you had real quick reflexes that time, charged right through a window into the building by the road.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You should have kept yourself hidden like before.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: That wasn't my knife last time.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Before you draw your sword, you might want to guess as to how many eyes are on you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Your knife has an insignia on its handle. You've come from a certain caravan.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: To be precise, the Yellow Sands do any job for coin. Armed escort is just one of our services.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I took a bag of rations from you and now you've come all this way to kill me over it?

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: You were a wanderer in the wilds on the brink of starvation, we would've turned a blind eye, if you had eaten it yourself.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: But you went and roughed up my friends in the process, and used those rations to save an outcast.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It is a habit of mine to share my meals. I've been saved by the kindness of others many times in the past, and I won't pass on the chance to save a life myself.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: That guy we threw out was no saint.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: After you saved him, he became obsessed with revenge, and hounded us out of our work.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Killing just him wouldn't be enough to make things right, now would it?

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: Augh!

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Sorry.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: M-M hou yisi, I didn't mean to disturb you, I'll come back later...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No, it was my mistake for drawing my sword. I've caused a misunderstanding, I see.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: We've closed up shop, but we didn't sell all of the salt and pepper scalecis we made for the day. The boss told me to give you some.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: It's fresh from the wok and still hot. No good when it gets cold.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: I see you don't have any free hands, so I'll just leave it on the counter, okay?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Doje.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: I hope you two enjoy it!

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Well, this is a surprise.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: You found yourself a quiet place to settle down.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: No, it's mere happenstance.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: These things, it's like they're encased in glass. If I were to brandish my sword, it would be all too easy to shatter them in carelessness.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Like right now?

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Ah. I just got an idea.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Since what you really owe us is money, there's no need for you to pay with your life.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Is money all you think about?

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Don't get me wrong. Our founding mission is to maintain order, uphold virtue, smite evil, that sort of thing. We're just looking to be properly compensated for our good deeds.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Since you love being a meddlesome busybody, you might as well meddle some more.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Have a look at this ledger.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Plenty of bounties for infamous robbers and serial killers in Lungmen.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: You help us out with a job, use the bounty to repay us, the city's less one bad guy, and you get to keep the peace.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: On the other hand, if you decide not to play nice with us... I'm afraid it would be rather hard for you to protect that peace, on this street at least.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: So you're saying that if they're in this ledger, they're either a robber or a killer?

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: You know, my mother says the grave that Lee tends... Its stone is totally blank!

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: She also doesn't go every year. It seems like out of the two decades or so her shop has been open, there's been a few years where she skipped the visit.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: She must have some secret buried deep in her heart, so secret that she can't even have the person's name carved on the stone.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: I don't know who it could be... or maybe it could be those people?

spans.text: I don't know who it could be... or maybe it could be

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I wasn't planning on staying here for so long. I should be in Yumen.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I'm sure someone in one of your supply transport teams can help me find a way there.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: If you can agree to this condition, I might be able to help you with your other issues.

steps.name: Customer
steps.text: Not having to deal with another pain in my ass here... Hmph, I'm glad you're so reasonable, Siuje.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I hope that's it.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Aiya, why are you here so early today? I only just opened up shop.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Every time you say you're not that interested in those CDs, but you've really gotten into them, haven't you?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I wouldn't say that many of them really interested me.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Well, there's lots of duds in there, so that's only natural. Any of them stand out to you?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I only remember thinking that most of the kung fu in them was all style, no substance.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Keh, you really didn't take an interest at all then, did you?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: These ones over here were outstanding, though.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Haha, I've gotten too old. My bones might ache all the time, but my eyes aren't so dim that I can't tell a skilled hand.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I suspect that anyone else would not have dared to try and free me from L.G.D. arrest.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Oh, I've got plenty of experience dealing with them.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Although it might be thanks to the many mistakes of my youth, if my silver tongue could help a girl in need, then I'd say it was all worth it.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Who taught you how to swing a sword?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: My father's... friends taught me the basics. The rest I taught myself over the course of my travels.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: I wouldn't know how to use one to stick a fin in a barrel.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Although I'd say you'd be better off not knowing. Best you keep that sword from spilling any blood. Just... don't end up like me.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Would you mind helping me hold the ladder? I need to swap those disks at the top for some newer ones.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Yesterday, it took to the afternoon to actually have any customers. My regulars usually only come once every twenty-four hours or so.
Qiubai looks down at a photograph she has on her of a young Liberi woman, her hair still not yet white with age.
It is a bounty for a bandit willing to kill for money, and that while her accomplices have mostly been executed, she alone remains at large many years later.
The shopkeep doesn't look back at her, focused on managing her store.
Out on the street, the shutters of the various stores and stalls all rise together with a thunderous crash, the neighbors greeting one another in familiar tones.
Hot cups of tea steam beside cash registers, while televisions blare out family sitcoms that have been running for over a hundred episodes.
The movies might not contain her enemies, but it was hard for them not to share one or two moments from her five years and thousands of li worth of travels.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Whose grave did you go to tend the other day?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: If you're so curious, you should come with me next time.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Well...
Qiubai slowly loosens her hand that has been tightly gripping the hilt of her sword.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: When I was young, my father taught me to repay hate with hate, while my mother taught me to repay kindness with kindness.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Where'd that come from, all of a sudden?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I'm setting out on my journey. I just wanted to express my gratitude.
She stuffs the photo with the bounty into a crack in the cash register drawer, then quickly steps out of the store.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Until we meet again.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: Oh hey, hasn't it been a few days since I last saw you? Want to come in to eat or...?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The rental shop's closed...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: When did that happen?

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: Eh? Oh, it just closed this evening.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: I waved hello to Lee earlier today. She told me she had something to do, so she closed up earlier than usual.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: That's good to know.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: She must be gone by now.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: Oh, yes, I saw her walk off.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: So uh, would you like to have a seat?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Sorry, I'm just passing through.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I doubt you'll be seeing her again. Too dangerous.

steps.name: Dai Pai Dong Waiter
steps.text: Dangerous? What are you talking about?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Don't worry about it. I'll take a look.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The key's still here...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It shouldn't be... What's happened to her?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Lee Loubaan!

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: I figured you might show.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You were thinking of leaving the shop to me, weren't you?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You decided that with all your past misdeeds and grudges dying with you, I could keep living here peacefully.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: If you don't like that idea, then be sure to give the key to someone who does.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: When will your enemies arrive?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You may have laid aside your arms at your age, but I still have mine in hand.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Put that sword of yours away and sit with me awhile.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Very well.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: I thank you for your kindness, both in letting me know about the bounty, and for trying to cover my escape.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: There are many who hate me, and it's taken them this long to catch me. Should be enough for me to have a right laugh at them, no?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You took the initiative and sought them out.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Otherwise, they would have had no way to hunt you down in this great city.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: It was my arrival that drew attention to this street, wasn't it?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: An item two or three decades old will break at the slightest touch.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: I'd say it wasn't you who broke the peace. If I hadn't helped you, I would have helped some other unfortunate swordsman or wandering child.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Either way, bloodstained as my hands are, isn't my death a good thing?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: So you were trying to get me to kill you that day, or at least expose you...?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: If I hadn't asked around, I'm afraid I would have believed the rumors about your evil past, and I would not have returned to see you.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Although the gang you were part of did many heinous deeds, you were not their ringleader, and you did not deserve to be hunted for so many years.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: And besides, the gang was almost completely wiped out, with only you making it out alive... Were you perhaps a traitor, or maybe an undercover agent all along?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: You've finally started to ask questions, I see.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Nobody else can give me the truth.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You're the only one I can ask.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I want to know... Do you really not care if your righteous deeds go unknown, if you can't explain your actions to the judge of the dead in the underworld?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: What's to care about?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: I wasn't an undercover agent for the imperial court, and I didn't steal from the rich to give to the poor.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Our group wandered the jianghu, and the best you could say is that we were a little bit nicer than other bandits. We bathed in blood. We were not righteous rebels, just hateful bastards.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: And that's why I wanted to stop you.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Once you go into jianghu, you can never leave.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Has Lungmen ever encountered a snowstorm before, Loubaan?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Nothing so dramatic. It just snows from time to time. Why?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I... don't understand.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: When I was young, my father taught me to repay hate with hate, while my mother taught me to repay kindness with kindness. This I know well.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: But my father also taught me of the river's expanse, and how it could take me to many places.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I've wandered for so long, but only now when I look back do I realize this land is far greater than any river, and there are many places that do not know the touch of flowing water.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Like Lungmen, for example, this nomadic city that can evade Catastrophe.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: The year that I was born, Jiangqi had just finished its spring sowing when a Catastrophe plunged it back into deepest winter. It snowed for the entirety of May.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I don't understand what exactly traps us, while the land is so vast. People say that they cannot leave the jianghu, but where do the raging rapids of the jiang start? Where is the far edge of the hu's still waters?

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Haha, some very good questions.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: If I don't make it to Yumen, I fear I will never understand.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I must meet that man...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I've just thought of something. Let's go for a walk. Together.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: That's enough thinking out of you.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: My enemies have been and gone. I drank my poisoned drink.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: My time is near.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You never did tell me whose grave this is, Loubaan.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: If you still have regrets, I... can at least help you finish the marker.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Haha, no need...

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: The grave... is mine.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You've been ready for a long time.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Whether or not you have someone to send you off, sooner or later, it comes knocking at your door.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Regrets are for the living. The dead? Not so much.
The old woman's flagging gaze is fixed on Qiubai for a long while, before slowly turning towards the gravestone.

steps.name: Rental Store Owner
steps.text: Say... This river of yours... Where does it flow to...?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Loubaan...
The old woman is no longer breathing.
Qiubai rests her body up against the gravestone, closing her eyes for her.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: She looked at the marker in her final moments, the one without a name...

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Maybe you really do care about what happens after you die?

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You were a bandit, or maybe you were a hero.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Or maybe you were just a woman who managed to settle all her jianghu feuds. Lee, the rental shop loubaan.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: You died over twenty years ago, on the day you settled down in Lungmen, or maybe you died today.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Maybe you didn't care... or maybe you've been trapped by this question your entire life.
This uncarved gravestone stands out in a public cemetery in Lungmen, as if it is waiting for an answer.
Qiubai draws her sword.

a.text: There's a lot of scrapped swords in the weapon shop. Go and sneak one out, nobody will notice. Then, I'll teach you how to use it.
Alright, look, here's how you chop, here's how you stab... Hey, hey, be careful with that!
Hey, are you alright? Scared the life outta me. If anything happened to you, he'd take my head...
Anyway, this sword's way too heavy for a little kid like you, so put it down. You can't let your sword fly out of your hands like that again!
Look at all the flowers I knocked loose! They're so pretty!
I want Father to see them...
Snow's not the only thing that's white.

steps.text: Her sword slashes forth.
The only thing on its point is a single white flower.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Grudges are difficult to break, which is why men are unable to escape, unable to walk away.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: But that is not a reason for me to lay down my sword.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Neither is it a reason for me to continue wielding it.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I've been to Yumen, Loubaan.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: I think I've found my answer now.

steps.name: Qiubai
steps.text: Doje.
The white flower falls from her blade onto the plinth before the gravestone. Qiubai turns to leave.
The stone stands, still uncarved.
